            remaining_time = t - (min(max_speed, v2) - v1 + 1)
            distance_increase += remaining_time * v2
        else:
            distance_increase = sum(range(v1, v2 + 1))
    else:
        distance_increase = 0

    # Calculate the maximum possible distance if speed decreases linearly
    if v1 >= v2:
        min_speed = v1 - d * (t - 1)

            distance_decrease = sum(range(v1, max(min_speed, v2) - 1, -1))
            remaining_time = t - (v1 - max(min_speed, v2))
            distance_decrease += remaining_time * v2
        else:
            distance_decrease = sum(range(v1, v2 - 1, -1))
    else:
        distance_decrease = 0

    return max(distance_increase, distance_decrease)
